summary: Targeted re-verification of the HIGH click-bubble bug from iteration_12 (ShopIngredientPicker clicks navigating to /recipe/:id). Mobile 390x844 on https://whatieat.preview.emergentagent.com/inspire. All 6 requested scenarios PASS: (1) shop-btn-0 opens shop-picker-dialog, URL stays /inspire; (2) tapping picker-item rows toggles selection ('Add 10' -> 'Add 9' -> back to 'Add 10') with URL unchanged; (3) 'None' chip sets 'Add 0 to shopping list' and disables the add button, 'All' restores 10, URL unchanged; (4) picker-add-btn persisted 10 items to localStorage wcie_shopping, dialog closed, URL still /inspire; (5) Escape and outside-click close the dialog with no navigation; (6) sanity - clicking the card title still navigates to /recipe/cc1246b5-.... No console errors captured during the runs. Fix (div with onClick e.stopPropagation() wrapping the picker inside the <article>) is confirmed working end-to-end.

issues: Image relevance still off: 'Savory Shakshuka' rendered a photo of hands over a pomegranate/salad plate; 'Spicy Veggie Tacos' image sits on a bright blue background clashing with the warm palette. Pre-existing MEDIUM issue from iteration_12 (loremflickr source), not part of this fix.

action_items: None for the click-bubble fix — verified fixed.
Still open from iteration_12 (not retested per request scope): Array.isArray guards for ingredients_used/missing_ingredients, and off-topic loremflickr images.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeCard.jsx:130 wrapper div only stops onClick; consider also stopping onPointerDown/onKeyDown if future card handlers use those events, or render the picker outside the <article> for a structurally safer fix.

Note: the missing-only chip (picker-select-missing) could not be exercised — none of the 4 /inspire recipes returned missing_ingredients, so the chip is not rendered. Behaviour is identical to the other chips (same click path), so risk is negligible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 scenarios pass; missing-only chip N/A - no missing ingredients in dataset)

seed_data_creation: none (localStorage only; wcie_shopping populated with 10 shakshuka ingredients during test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Click-bubble bug (iteration_12 HIGH) is FIXED and verified. /inspire prefetches other categories into localStorage key manifeast_inspire_cache — clear it for cold-load tests. Remaining open items from iteration_12: non-array ingredients_used producing single-letter chips + duplicate React key warnings, and irrelevant recipe images.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous RCA: ShopIngredientPicker was a React child of the clickable <article>, so Radix portal clicks still bubbled up the React tree to the card's onOpen navigation. Fix wraps the picker in <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>, which halts the synthetic event before it reaches the article handler — confirmed by URL remaining /inspire across every interaction inside the dialog while the card body still navigates correctly.
